catalogueTitle: Traveller misses a connection; airline reprotection is reported, not yet whole-trip recovered
note: Jordan Hale (ait-draft-09) flies ZIPAIR ZG023 LAX→NRT connecting to ZG053 NRT→SIN with a genuine ~2h40m connection (provider-locked). Progressive Atlas delay/schedule evidence on the inbound eventually makes ZG053 impossible. The airline reports a next-morning TR885-class reprotection (~08:20→14:35). With finals showcase at 20:45, TR885 clears the 360min buffer (370 ≥ 360) — do not call TR885 inadequate. TR867 (~20:45 arrival) is the inadequate slower alternative in inventory. Closed hero path: reconcile traveller report + reported reprotection, then Northstar whole-trip viability ranks evidenced TR885-class recovery. Simulated seam: SIMULATED_EXTERNAL_EVENT / REPLAY Atlas; transit hotel / JP entry / insurance remain context only.
